hook: A claimed shortcut for one of cryptography's hardest problems.

beats.say: In a new preprint, researchers from Zhejiang University claim a deterministic algorithm for the discrete logarithm problem that runs in subexponential time.
The claim covers discrete logarithms in prime fields and on prime order elliptic curves, with a running time of p to the power of little o of one.
There is a catch. The result only holds if OpenAI's October twenty twenty six Cauchy Hermite Boolean tensor contraction construction holds, so for now it is a conditional claim.
